description: The Center for Medical Cannabis and Psilocybin hosted the fifth Dosage, Administration and Clinical Practice Committee meeting for the Medical Psilocybin Advisory Board. The Chair, Ian Dunn, facilitated discussion and approval for recommendation- Preparation session standards, Clinical screening & eligibility, Informed consent, Treatment orientation, and Boundaries & participant protections.
